hero.bio: I'm passionate about software project management, requirements gathering, technical documentation, and working with agile teams.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack developer focused on the backend, passionate about building solid, scalable systems aligned with software engineering best practices. I'm currently in my eighth semester of Software Engineering at FESC, hold a Associate Degree in Software Development, and have complementary training in Software Architectures, constantly strengthening my skills in development, analysis, and solution design.
about.p2: I have {{experience}} of experience at the FESC Software Laboratory, where I worked as an intern and now serve as a Software Development Technical Assistant. I enjoy every stage of the software lifecycle, from requirements gathering and functional analysis to implementation, documentation, and agile teamwork, always focused on efficient, maintainable, high-value solutions.
